about: Apply for a new UAE residence permit, linked to an Emirates ID application.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. New residence permit. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: What is needed depends on the reason: study, retirement, property ownership, family of a resident, family of a UAE or GCC national, investor, or employment
The passport must be valid for at least 6 months
documents: Family: attested marriage contract, children's birth certificates, proof of kinship, and proof of income and housing
Employment: medical report, employment contract, and the work permit
Student: approval from the education authority and an enrolment certificate
timing: The person must be in the UAE for at most 60 days from entry to finish the steps
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
